content: If the data element DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT is configured, the aging counter mapping shall be based on a count-up mechanism from 0 to DemAgingCycleCounterThreshold (refer to ISO-14229-1[2], Annex D).
If the data element DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT is configured, the aging counter mapping shall be based on a count-up mechanism from 0 to DemAgingCycleCounterThreshold (refer to ISO-14229-1[2], Annex D).

If the DemAgingCycleCounterThreshold is configured, then the value of the data element DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT shall be based on a count-up mechanism from 0 to DemAgingCycleCounterThreshold (refer to ISO-14229-1[2], Annex D).
